headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 19, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jacob Gonzalez had a standout performance at the plate, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs. In other news, the Chicago Cubs took down the Minnesota Twins 6-2, with Matthew Boyd earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Stephen Kolek of the Kansas City Royals, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right flexor strain. The Athletics' Justin Sterner has also been placed on the 15-day injured list with a right knee chondromalacia.

The Chicago Cubs made a significant trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles also made a trade, acquiring right fielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jacob Gonzalez had a standout performance at the plate, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Guardians in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, snapping their winning streak. Travis Bazzana led the Guardians' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key 8th homer that scored Steven Kwan.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Twins 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 6-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Matthew Boyd earning the win. Kody Clemens led the Twins' offense with two home runs and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Shut Down Mets in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 6-1 victory over the New York Mets, with Jesús Luzardo earning the win after 5.0 IP, 7 K, 1 ER, 2 BB, 2 H. Trea Turner led the Mets' offense with 3 H, 1 HR, 1 RBI, and 4 AB.

top_news.title: **Royals Roster Update: Stephen Kolek Placed on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals right-handed pitcher Stephen Kolek has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right flexor strain.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Aaron Civale in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett.
